1. Mr. Krishan Mohan Joshi, learned 
counsel holding brief of Mr. V.K Kaparuwan, 
learned counsel for the revisionist and Mr. 
Ramji Srivastava, learned counsel for the 
respondent nos.1 and 2. 
2. Mr. Ramji Srivastava, Advocate, 
submits that he has received instructions 
from the respondent nos.1 and 2. He prays 
for and is granted ten days’ time to file his 
vakalatnama on behalf of the said 
respondents.

Union Of India
 ----- Revisionist 
 Versus
Shailendra Singh Negi and another 
--Respondents
Hon'ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. V. K. Kaparwan (through V.C.) and 
Mr. Mukesh Kumar Kaparwan, learned counsel 
for the revisionist.
2. Notice has been accepted on behalf of 
respondent by Mr. Ramji Srivastav, Advocate. 
3. Heard. 
4. Admit. 
5. Learned counsel for the respondent prays 
for and is granted two weeks time to file 
objection. 
6. List after three weeks. 
7. In case, the revisionist deposits the entire 
decretal amount before the court below within a 
period of two weeks from today, the effect and 
operation of the order dated 22.08.2026, passed 
by the learned IInd Additional District Judge, in 
L.A. Execution Case No. 79 of 2014, S.S.Negi 
and another vs. Collector & another, shall 
remain stayed till the next date of listing. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.)
 30.10.2026
Kaushal
